Idle RPG does not collect, transmit or share any personal data.

• Save game and settings (character, equipment, gold, language, sound) are stored only locally on your device; there is no cloud backup.
• The app requests no permissions and does not open internet connections itself. There are no accounts, ads, analytics or tracking. The only third-party component is Google’s Play library “In-App Updates”: it asks, via Play services, whether an update is available; the app sends no game or personal data.
• Voluntary donation: the “Donate” button opens an external Stripe payment page in your browser. The app passes no data; the payment is handled solely by Stripe (see Stripe’s privacy policy).
• Save export and import are manual via file or clipboard. Data leaves your device only if you share it yourself.
• Uninstalling the app deletes all data. An import overwrites the current save game.
• The app is not directed at children under 13.

Contact: rene.puf@gmail.com
